svg.text: Build, deploy and runtime are three different service accounts: the builder cannot deploy, the deployer cannot sign, the runtime has no roles · No keys anywhere

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Registry tags are immutable and deploys use digests · prod is never public (IAM-authenticated) · rollback is a first-class, approved rollout

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Binary Authorization policy is project-wide: destroying this stack restores the project to allow-all

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A push runs Cloud Build as a dedicated service account; unit tests run first

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The image is built and saved as a tarball; a CycloneDX SBOM is produced and Trivy scans it: any CRITICAL vulnerability with a fix fails the build

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only a passing image is pushed (tags are immutable); Cloud Build attaches SLSA provenance and the SBOM is stored against the digest

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cloud KMS signs two attestations for the digest: built-by-pipeline and scan-passed (different keys; only the build SA may sign)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Cloud Deploy release pins the digest and rolls out to staging automatically

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cloud Run asks Binary Authorization on every revision: both attestations must verify, otherwise the revision is denied and audit-logged

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Promotion to prod is an explicit step, then a human approves

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prod rolls out as a canary (25 %, 50 %, 100 %, advancing after a soak); a bad canary is cancelled and rolled back with one approved command
